model: ROLEX Day-Date 40 228235 (40 mm Everose gold, fluted Everose bezel, chocolate dial with Roman numerals and day / date windows, Cyclops, President bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Day-Date 40 (228235 chocolate; the 228238 row is skipped, no later variants queued): case and lugs with the mirrored crown flank from the photo silhouette, polished flange + chamfer + 76 real flutes (152 flat facets with the photo's zig-zag in / out outline), domed crystal, Cyclops date lens, drawn gold baton hands, fluted crown and the President bracelet (brushed barrel outer links, polished centre links with the measured dark gaps) at the photo's joints; dial, Roman numerals / indices, day-of-week window at 12, date numeral, print and the photographed hands come from one native photo map or the projected steel photo. Native 1920 x 2857 photo, 22.42 px/mm, no texture scaling.

case.note: outline = photo silhouette (lug top y 908.5, lug bottom y 1982.5; the crown rows 1366..1508 take the left flank mirrored about the case centre x 960); the slab slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: boundary k = 0..151 counter-clockwise from 12 o'clock; long boundaries (even k: 12 and 9 o'clock) reach r 17.15..19.60 mm, short ones 17.37..19.45 mm; flange 15.70..16.78 mm (grey polished band)

lens.note: Cyclops: outline = trace.lens_mm (rim outer edge, barrel shaped, about 7.4 x 5.8 mm), rim chamfer 0.18 mm then a flat top inset 0.55 mm; shows the projected photo of the lens

hands.note: hands = drawn outlines from edge scans (trace.hands[name].outline_mm) as flat polygons; the gold faces, dark facets and rims stay in the projected photo

crown.note: fluted Day-Date crown (no guards): flutes x 1410..1450, cap to 1467, axis 0.58 mm below the pivot

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind. A Jubilee: columns outer / semi / centre / semi / outer, 4 boundaries per bounds row, pieces and z_semi per kind.

bracelet.note: President bracelet: three columns, brushed semicircular outer links (modelled as sine-arch barrels, joints = silhouette steps) and polished centre links separated by the measured dark gaps. Rows (px, 22.42 px/mm, pivot (960, 1424)): outer top 695.5 / 740 / 813.5, end 686; outer bottom 2103 / 2322 / 2405.5 / 2466.5 / 2506, end 2513; centre dark gaps top 706..712, 752..760, 832..847, bottom 2001..2008, 2124..2135, 2234..2246, 2327..2344, 2395..2412, 2445..2465, 2489..2503, end 2513; column lines x 858 / 1062 (top), 857.5 / 1062 (bottom). Outer link edges come from the alpha silhouette.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
